answer_text: The only relevant summary (community_9) includes DemoBooth_Intel (CAM_04) and DemoBooth_NVIDIA (CAM_05) on 2025-12-08 from 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z–2025-12-08T23:00:00Z (events between 2025-12-08T00:02:26Z and 2025-12-08T23:59:14Z) and reports a single overall peak head_count of 500.
